# Fior.in

> Portfolio of Luciano Fiorin, a senior software engineer, designer, educator, and board-game creator.

## About

Fiorin works across TypeScript and JavaScript platforms, microfrontends, distributed systems on AWS, AI/LLM engineering, visual editing, 3D modeling, game development, and computer science education. Employment history is in the resume; side projects are listed separately.

## Fiorin Games Studio

- Project # (2026): An original tabletop game for 2–6 players, currently in development. Details remain under wraps.
- Project # Simulator (2026): A simulation engine for automated gameplay testing, rule validation, and balance analysis of an unreleased board game.
- Project # Board Generator (2026): A procedural board generator for creating, configuring, and experimenting with tabletop game layouts.
- Project # Character Manager (2026): A character management tool for designing, organizing, and balancing playable characters in an original board game.
- L1XØ! (2026): A playful tabletop game about garbage collection. Drive miniature trucks, collect trash, and deliver it to the depot. Designed for 1–2 players, ages 3+, with quick 10-minute sessions.

## Projects

- Codebase Archaeologist (2026): A local-first desktop tool that maps software architecture, detects dependency cycles and complexity hotspots, and analyzes change impact using static analysis and Git history. — https://github.com/fiorin/codebase-archeologist
- arcRevil (2026): AI-powered architectural PR reviewer that detects design violations, dependency issues, and architectural regressions using static analysis and LLMs. — https://github.com/fiorin/arcRevil
- Fiorin Games Studio (2026): Independent tabletop game studio developing original games through mechanical design, simulation, rapid prototyping, and custom physical components. — https://fior.in/games
- Restyle (2026): Image style converter using Google Gemini API and vision models for custom art generation. — https://github.com/fiorin/restyle
- OurStl (2026): A STL extractor and mesh downloader for web-based 3D generation tools. — https://github.com/fiorin/ourstl
- Abominapp (2025): Abomination randomizer app for Zombicide tabletop sessions. — https://abominapp.vercel.app/
- Ruins (2023): A custom faction mod for Heroes of Might and Magic III. Designed from scratch, encompassing original 3D creature art, custom lore, asset integration, and game balance tuning. — http://heroescommunity.com/viewthread.php3?TID=44951
- VCMI (2018): Open-source C++ contribution enabling unique custom hero sprites in battle for the Heroes of Might and Magic III engine rewrite. — https://github.com/fiorin/vcmi
- Coding Lab (2018): Open educational materials, including curricula, exercises, and course resources, developed for undergraduate Algorithms and Database courses at UTFPR. — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12jfbklSXpU0ER53bB6LRWWCUbJnYQIdU?usp=sharing
- p0rte1ra (2017): Desktop livestock management system built with cross-platform web tech. — https://github.com/fiorin/p0rte1ra
- Don't Starve Together (2016): A custom playable character for Don't Starve Together, created as an exploration of character design, gameplay mechanics, scripting, and mod development. — https://steamcommunity.com/id/sarna/myworkshopfiles/?appid=322330
- Brawl (2016): Experimental 2D fighting game built with Phaser, focused on exploring game loop architecture and the underlying systems of real-time gameplay. — https://github.com/fiorin/brawl
- Pto.css (2015): Lightweight utility-first CSS framework built as a Bootstrap alternative. — https://github.com/fiorin/ptocss
- Bomberman (2011): Bomberman-inspired 2D game built from scratch with vanilla JavaScript, featuring grid-based movement, bombs, explosions, collisions, and real-time gameplay. — https://github.com/fiorin/bomberman2010.js
- Quarto Universitário (2009): Custom WordPress theme architecture developed and deployed for university media platforms, with a focus on reusable components, content management, and scalable publishing workflows. — https://fior.in/img/quartouniversitario.webp
